body: Wade-code-review: Adding one remedy to this thread (check 3A, a gated test must reach its assertion). The option-less required build is one gap. A second one is the hardware gate inside the two kernel cases: `t/t_amx_numerics.cpp:316-318` and `:330-332` do `WARN(...); return;` when `available()` is false, so on a runner without AMX (the `cmake-single-platform.yml` label set `[self-hosted, fpga, test, avx512]` includes the AMD hosts) Catch2 reports both cases as passed with their 4 SECTIONs never entered. Replacing the two `WARN(...); return;` pairs with Catch2's `SKIP("AMX unavailable on this host")` makes the summary count them as skipped instead of passed. Catch2 is v3.7.1 here (`cmake/versions.cmake:26`) and `t/t_disk_cache.cpp:182` already uses `SKIP`. The exit code stays 0, so the slice line keeps `passed`.
